subject.title: feat(feeds): serve signed catalog queries and changes

question: Should ClawHub preserve the existing raw `/api/v1/feeds/plugins` contract while introducing DSSE as a separate/versioned transport, or intentionally replace that route once the signing and OpenClaw consumer rollout are approved?
rationale: Current main and its specification define the existing route as an unsigned raw-byte contract, while this branch deliberately changes its representation and availability behavior; that compatibility and rollout policy cannot be selected safely by automated review.

options.title: Preserve raw route; add signed transport separately
options.body: Keep the current feed response and validators intact, then expose DSSE query/change functionality through new or versioned endpoints with a documented consumer migration.

options.title: Approve an intentional DSSE replacement
options.body: Accept the breaking route transition only with an approved signing-secret rollout, trust-root handoff, consumer compatibility plan, and upgrade evidence.

options.title: Pause the stacked transport work
options.body: Defer this branch until the signer and durable-distribution prerequisites have merged and the public feed contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve raw route; add signed transport separately
recommendation.body: Keep the current feed response and validators intact, then expose DSSE query/change functionality through new or versioned endpoints with a documented consumer migration.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contributor across the linked feed distribution, signer, and transport stack; a repository owner must still make the product decision.
